pages.title: shiori_novella
pages.body:
A [[Virtual YouTuber]] and member of the 3rd generation of [[hololive English]]. The archiver and the de-facto leader of hololive English [[holoadvent|-Advent-]]. Designed by [[Kayahara]].

She is portrayed with [[long hair|long]] [[split-color hair|split-color]] [[black hair|black]] and [[grey hair]], [[yellow eyes]], and [[large breasts]]. Her neck-body gap is covered with an apparently sentient black goo that seems to held her neck to her body together, though it is often omitted in some fan works.
